name: Capivara Booster v2.3.0 (Rust Edition)
notes: ## Added

- Live dashboard telemetry: CPU model with current load %, RAM usage bar, GPU name, active power plan and uptime, all from a single PowerShell query; new "Free RAM (Standby)" action via NtSetSystemInformation

- Cache & Junk Cleaner redesigned: summary hero (total found, selected, freeable now), professional table with category and real on-disk sizes, Select All / Recommended presets, per-item progress and safely skipped in-use files reported at the end
- Update completion feedback: typed DownloadOutcome (bytes, path, launched) with a localized success banner; Windows Update driver installs now surface reboot-required explicitly
- CI/CD: every release now syncs READMEs, defines the repo homepage as the landing page and regenerates releases-data.json without BOM
## Changed
- All PowerShell/CMD scripts remain windowless (CREATE_NO_WINDOW) and log exact [OK] results per module
## Fixed
- In-app updater stuck without completion signal after download
- Driver status row not updating after a successful one-click update
## Performance
- Dashboard telemetry consolidated into one WMI/PowerShell round-trip (was several)
## PT-BR
- Telemetria ao vivo no painel: CPU com carga, barra de RAM, GPU, plano de energia e uptime em uma consulta; botão Liberar RAM (Standby)

- Limpar Cache repaginado: resumo (total, selecionados, liberável agora), tabela com categoria e tamanhos reais, Selecionar tudo/Recomendados, progresso por item e arquivos em uso pulados com segurança
- Confirmação de conclusão do atualizador com banner localizado; atualização de driver agora avisa reinício obrigatório
- CI/CD: cada release sincroniza READMEs, define a homepage do repo e regenera o JSON da landing sem BOM

name: Capivara Booster v2.2.0 (Rust Edition)
notes: ## Added

- Driver Booster: one-click driver updates via Windows Update (WUApiLib) with pnputil backup beforehand, professional status table (Updated / Update available) and a full hardware profile card (exact motherboard model, BIOS, CPU, GPU, RAM, Windows build)

- Updater popup: discreet bottom-right notification with release notes and a working "Update now" button (downloads, verifies SHA-256 and launches the elevated installer); Dismiss remembers the version
- App version badge in the sidebar now reads the real version at runtime via get_app_version

- Path of Exile 2: texture quality, engine multithreading and VSync off added to the competitive profile, plus a live boost (high process priority and 0.5 ms timer resolution) when the game is already running
- Counter-Strike 2: NtSetTimerResolution-based 0.5 ms timer resolution while boosting
## Changed
- Console redesigned as an "Activity" feed: only important events (OK confirmations, errors, module actions) are shown, capped at 80 lines, with a new pill-style toggle button
- All PowerShell/CMD scripts run with CREATE_NO_WINDOW: zero console popups
- requireAdministrator manifest embedded via tauri_build: GameDVR, CS2 IFEO and bcdedit writes no longer fail with access denied
## Fixed
- Access denied (os error 5) on GameDVR and CS2 IFEO registry writes
- Sidebar showing raw i18n keys ([Nav_Poe], [Nav_Drivers], [Nav_LowLatency])
- HPET card stuck on "Verificando..." (bcdedit now queried with proper quoting and a fallback)
- Driver scan returning empty lists (ConvertTo-Json broke on large WMI output; now CSV)
- TaskDialogIndirect startup crash by declaring Common Controls v6 in the manifest
## PT-BR

- Driver Booster: atualização de driver em 1 clique via Windows Update com backup pnputil antes, tabela profissional de status e card com o hardware completo (placa-mãe exata, BIOS, CPU, GPU, RAM e Windows)
- Popup de atualização discreto com notas da versão e botão "Atualizar agora" funcional (download com SHA-256 e instalador elevado); botão Depois lembra a versão
- Versão real do app no canto superior esquerdo, lida em tempo de execução
- Path of Exile 2: qualidade de textura, multithreading da engine e VSync off no perfil competitivo, mais boost ao vivo (prioridade alta e timer de 0,5 ms) com o jogo aberto
- Counter-Strike 2: resolução de timer de 0,5 ms via NtSetTimerResolution
- Console redesenhado como feed de "Atividade": só eventos importantes, limite de 80 linhas e novo botão pílula
- Scripts PowerShell/CMD com CREATE_NO_WINDOW: nenhuma janela piscando
- Fim do "Acesso negado" no GameDVR, IFEO do CS2 e bcdedit (manifesto embutido)
- Fim das chaves cruas no menu, do HPET eterno em "Verificando..." e do crash TaskDialogIndirect na abertura
